title: Five Stars
text: Five Stars. Very nice and nice looking pillow protectors.  Also very comfortable.

product_metadata.title: Waterguard Waterproof Pillow Protectors - Zippered Bug Proof, Quilted Thick Pillow Covers - 100% Cotton Shell Pillow Encasement - King Size (20x36) Set of 2
features: PROTECTS WELL: These pillow protectors are 100% waterproof, It will keep your pillow clean and free from stains, dust, and dirt.
SUPERIOR QUALITY AND COMFORT: With its soft, quilted, cushiony top, it will keep your neck and head supported and comfortable all night long. It’s like having a comforter wrapped around your pillow!

COTTON TOP, MICROFIBER FILLED: With our 100% cotton top, you’ll always be on the cold side of the pillow. Unlike polyester, which can make you sweat at night, our cotton pillow protectors are breathable, cool and Only Quality Fabrics Used.
QUIET: No crinkling noises when you lay your head on them. The only thing you’ll hear is the sound of your own Zzz’s from how well you’re sleeping.
MACHINE WASH AND DRY: Machine wash in warm water. Use bleach only when you need to remove stains. Tumble dry only. Do not iron. Do not dry clean.
